blue_strategy.rule: for each rank 1..100, derive one value 1..16 from domain-separated SHA256(preregistration_digest,target_issue,rank); attach the identical rank-wise value to model and random arms

candidate_generation.model_ranking: descending frozen model 33-event Bernoulli log score
candidate_generation.proposal_pool: reuse deterministic cryptographic legal six-of-33 sampling without replacement
candidate_generation.random_baseline: independent deterministic uniform legal six-of-33 sampling without replacement
candidate_generation.seed_rule: domain-separated SHA256 of preregistration digest, target issue, arm identity, and model digest where applicable

checkpoint.pre_draw_deadline: 17:00:00 Asia/Shanghai on the official Tue/Thu/Sun draw date
checkpoint.target_selection: first official issue after now whose 17:00 checkpoint deadline remains satisfiable; otherwise skip to the next legal issue

frozen_contract.configuration_drift_rule: any semantic change to estimator, features, parameters, cadence, scoring, baseline, candidate budget, blue strategy, endpoint, threshold, checkpoint, or decision policy invalidates the active lineage and requires a new preregistration before further collection
frozen_contract.historical_training_boundary: latest durable audited settled issue strictly before target_issue; target or future rows forbidden
frozen_contract.missing_issue_rule: an issue without a valid timely checkpoint does not count and is never backfilled; continue with the next legal issue without changing target 120

requirements: verify immutable checkpoint existed before official draw time
compute frozen model and legal-uniform probability endpoint
record paired ticket support metrics without changing the primary endpoint
increment Cohort A at most once
trigger exactly one next-issue mechanical refit
post_draw_settlement.trigger: durable audited draw-sync completion for the sealed target issue

probability_scoring_rule.baseline: sum over 33 binary events of log2 Bernoulli(Y_i;2/11)
probability_scoring_rule.candidate: sum over 33 binary events of log2 Bernoulli(Y_i;q_i)
probability_scoring_rule.settled_pair_difference: model endpoint minus legal-uniform endpoint for the same official issue

frozen_contract.refit_cadence: after each durable audited post-draw settlement, refit once on the complete expanding legal history strictly before the next target issue

terminal_rules_at_120.CONTINUE_LONG_HORIZON_RESEARCH: all integrity gates pass, mean >= 0.01 bits/issue, and preregistered two-sided 95 percent interval lower bound > 0
terminal_rules_at_120.INVALID_OPERATIONAL_STUDY: any late checkpoint, future access, duplicate issue, identity drift, unregistered semantic repair, missing immutable artifact, replay mismatch, or unprovable cohort identity
terminal_rules_at_120.OPERATIONALLY_INCONCLUSIVE: neither continue nor stop; do not extend Cohort A or choose another window post hoc
terminal_rules_at_120.STOP_PREDICTIVE_RESEARCH: mean <= -0.01 bits/issue or preregistered two-sided 95 percent interval upper bound < 0
